Science Campus, Bongaigaon University
Newly Introduced Programmes (2025-2026)
Following the historic upgrade to a constituent science campus of Bongaigaon University, we have expanded our academic portfolio. In addition to our foundational programs, we now offer advanced **M.Sc. Programmes** along with undergraduate offerings in **Applied Anthropology**, **Geology**, and **Economics (Major)**.
